name: Dodo Pizza
note: Pizza chain, partner of HC Sochi (2026/27 club partners page; logo links to dodopizza.ru/SOCHI). Lead: brand of Dodo Brands, founded by Fyodor Ovchinnikov; Dodo Brands remains privately held (long-announced IPO not completed as of 2026) and the Sochi club partnership is with the local franchise unit, whose operator was not identified — not rated.
